name: NeRF with Per-Image Embeddings
aliases: NeRF with Global Lighting Optimization Embeddings
definition: A model variant that learns a per-image embedding for each scene and injects it into the NeRF MLP during color prediction.
summary: NeRF with Per-Image Embeddings learns distinct vectors per image to model lighting variations, neutralizing them at test time to produce a consistent, photometrically averaged reconstruction.
